name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / Green Chile Project

values.StartLocation: El Paso Natural Gas interconnect, Dona Ana County
values.EndLocation: Project Jupiter gas-fired power plant, Dona Ana County

researcher_notes: Qualifies as new_row. No roster row: P0273 is the Main Line and P7840 the Desert Southwest Expansion; neither is this lateral. Sponsor Energy Transfer (Transwestern Pipeline Company). Concrete step: FERC blanket-certificate prior notice filed 1/29/2026, docket CP26-80; FERC staff and environmental groups protested April 2026. Length 17 mi (about 27.4 km) is over the 25 km threshold. EIA August 2026 release, sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', Excel row 59: Applied, 17 mi, 400 MMcf/d, 24 in, cost 60 million, intrastate flag, in-service target August 2026. Source New Mexico article of April 14, 2026 confirms the 17-mile length, the 60 million dollar cost, and Energy Transfer filing on Jan 29. EIA cites a Source NM article, so the two are not counted as independent. Not independently checked in the FERC docket: the 24-inch diameter and 400 MMcf/d capacity come from EIA only; EIA's text says 400,000 Dth/d. Owner and Parent copied from sibling row P0273 (not an exact entity match for Transwestern Pipeline Co). Start and end are county-level only. Route: none found, no official GIS located; route type unavailable until the FERC filing map is read. Location differs from EIA state-trust-land reroute noted in March 2026.
